title: Localization of coefficients commutes with bounded-below direct image
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$ and a finite subextension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ of $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, and put $A=\mathcal O_E$. Let $f:X\to Y$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. For $Z=X,Y$ let $A_Z=p_Z^*\underline A$, $E_Z=p_Z^*\underline E$ be the pulled-back condensed coefficients [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring, sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]. For every bounded-below $C\in D(\operatorname{Mod}(A_X))$ [sk-def-sfb-derived-categories], the canonical coefficient-change morphism
$$E_Y\otimes^L_{A_Y}Rf_{*,A}C\longrightarrow Rf_{*,E}(E_X\otimes^L_{A_X}C)$$
is an isomorphism. Here the direct images are the ordinary ambient module derived functors [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull]; the map is adjoint to extension of the $A$-coefficient counit after the canonical pullback/tensor identification [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback]. No completeness, constructibility or finite Tor amplitude is assumed.

proof.text: Equip the finite intermediate field E with PadicAlgCl.normedFieldOfAlgebra and the normed Q_ell algebra structure obtained from norm_extends. The valuation-ring subring, topology, continuous-function condensed ring and inclusion of [def-weil-pbc-continuous-integral-coefficients] are definitionally the published padicIntegersRingObj and padicIntegersRingObjToContinuousMapRingObj. Thus all of the existing continuous-integral localization constructions apply directly to the actual internal module categories and actual coefficient inclusion. No section-ring encoding change is necessary. The proved private equality-transport helper packages the coefficient inclusion as an arrow of commutative monoid objects and substitutes its equality with the continuous-integral arrow before instantiating derived module categories. This is equality elimination only; it avoids repeated definitional conversion of the valuation-ring data inside large derived-category types.

Put a=integralScalarMap, G=Rf_* on integral internal modules, L_X,L_Y the derived scalar extensions and U_X,U_Y the exact derived restrictions. The published derivedComapLowerStarIso gives kappa : Rf_* on E modules followed by U_Y isomorphic to U_X followed by G. By the definition of derivedPushHom as pushHomOfComapIso, the Mathlib unit_mateEquiv_symm identity and the inverse equations of kappa give eta_(G C) followed by g = G(eta_C), for g=U_Y(beta_C) followed by kappa_(L_X C). This is an elementary general adjunction calculation, written as the proved private lemma mate_unit_comap; it is for the specified map, not an arbitrary arrow between the objects. The exactness hypothesis is supplied by the final clause of [det-prop-sfb-qlbar-colimit-x-invert-ell], as in the definition of localizedDirectImageComparison; equivalently the proved continuous-integral scalar exactness instance specializes to the identical inclusion. The Cartesian coefficient identifications [sk-prop-sfb-cartesian-coefficients] are the canonical condensedPullbackHom identifications underlying this comparison; their unit-route module stays imported. The internal calculation uses these canonical source identifications directly, without the section-ring encoding.

G is additive by the existing Functor.additive_rightDerivedFunctor instance, applied to the additive lowerStar functor. The bounded-below right derived functor applied to the object (C,hC) is bounded below by its subtype property. Transport that property along rightDerivedFunctorPlusCompatibility, using invariance under isomorphism, to see that G C is bounded below. Form the canonical localization cocones cX,cY of C and G C from [def-weil-pbc-integral-localization-telescope], and d=G(cX) precomposed by the inverse additive scalar-sequence comparison. The zero legs are the scalar adjunction units; the preceding mate identity therefore gives cY_0 followed by g = d_0. Multiplication by ell on d.pt is invertible: it is invertible on L_X C, and additive U_X and G carry this isomorphism to scalar multiplication at d.pt. The invertibility is the proved derived_nsmul_isIso helper in [lem-weil-pbc-continuous-constructible-integral-image], which applies to every ambient E-derived object, without constructibility.

Fix any q in Z. By [lem-weil-pbc-integral-localization-homology-colimit], H^q maps the lifted cocone cY to a colimit; by [lem-weil-pbc-integral-localization-push-continuity], H^q composed with G maps the lifted cX to a colimit. Transport the latter along the identity-component scalar-sequence isomorphism to obtain the H^q-colimit of lifted d. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-integral-localization-mate] to cY,d,g and H^q, using the zero-leg equation and invertibility of ell on d.pt. Every H^q(g) is an isomorphism, hence so is g by [lem-weil-pbc-unbounded-derived-iso-cohomology].

Derived scalar restriction U_Y reflects isomorphisms. On ordinary modules this follows by reflection along the faithful forgetful functor, since restriction leaves the underlying arrow unchanged. On derived categories, its homology comparison and ordinary reflection, followed by [lem-weil-pbc-unbounded-derived-iso-cohomology], prove reflection. Since U_Y(beta_C)=g followed by the inverse of kappa, this map is invertible, and reflection gives IsIso beta_C. The coefficient inclusions agree definitionally, and proof irrelevance identifies the exactness witnesses, so beta_C is exactly localizedDirectImageComparison ell E f C.

proof_origin.place: HRS Lemma 5.3(1), proof of (5.4), and Lemma 5.6; same internal telescope proof as the proved ContinuousIntegralPushComparison, with only the cohomological lower bound used.
proof_origin.note: K8: the internal coefficient objects and inclusion are definitionally the continuous-integral ones under the induced norm. This avoids all section-ring normalization and the separate scalar-change-unit theorem. The mate-unit identity is proved from Mathlib adjunction mates; the existing localization homology, continuity and cocone criterion supply the telescope argument. The internal telescope proof is kept abstract in the normed field; the four private helpers are fully proved. Equality of the bundled point coefficient arrows is substituted before constructing module categories, and tensor exactness instances are cached locally. This repairs elaboration cost without changing a coefficient construction or any public signature.
